items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge (Dot, due Sun 28 Feb 2027); Clear the drainage ditch (Hal, due Mon 1 Mar 2027); Return the borrowed rotavator (Josef, due Wed 10 Mar 2027); Renew the public liability insurance (Tomas, due Sun 14 Mar 2027).

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through), and send round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes — getting the water meter replaced (the council visit is not booked yet) and fixing the main gate lock (waiting with the Council estates team).
